scope: Same boot, BO_PUBLISH_COPY for every case. One matrix executable; common float diagnostic client/app, only server numeric implementation and socket codec vary. Three 16-move bursts per paused/active condition; idle IPC 2 warmups + 20 samples. Native timings exclude UART/capture. Lower is better.

fixed-binary.scope: Board-local native client timings; UART, capture and optical latency excluded. Three sequential 16-point bursts per condition. Async may omit intermediate positions.

matrix-baseline.scope: Three live-app trials. Twenty source positions at 10 Hz; one HTTP request in flight, newest queued coordinate only in BOTH modes. PC monotonic timestamps; HDMI includes USB capture/polling delay, not optical latency. Native acceptance durations exclude HTTP/UART overhead.
